js: (async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const live=st.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted&&c.kind!=='reply');const ids=live.slice(0,2).map(c=>c.id);const out=[];for(const id of ids){const el=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+id+'"]');const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.x+20,clientY:r.y+12,pointerId:41,buttons:1}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.x+20,clientY:r.y+12,pointerId:41}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const bar=document.querySelector("[data-im=\"card-toolbar\"]");const btn=bar?[...bar.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='移出组'):null;if(btn){btn.click();out.push(id+':moved')}else{out.push(id+':no-btn')}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900))}const st2=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();return JSON.stringify({out,groups:st2.state.groups.map(g=>({name:g.name,members:g.members.length})),cards:st2.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted).map(c=>({id:c.id,x:c.x,y:c.y}))})})()
